title: Optimization Suggestions (Console) — E2E test cases checklist (beta)
linked_artifacts: Linear: ENG-19377 (RBAC permissions for Optimize suggestions)
Linear: ENG-19402 (Telemetry events for suggestions funnel)
GitHub: redwood/pr-21957 (Console UI add Suggestions view beta)
GitHub: redwood/pr-22063 (Compute job retries + staleness surfaced)
Slack: #support thread 1771741044 (early feedback: estimates seem off)
content:
Purpose
- QA-oriented checklist for end-to-end coverage of the Optimization Suggestions (batching/caching) beta in Console.
- Primary goals: validate correct gating (feature flag + RBAC), correctness of list/detail flows, robustness to missing/lagging telemetry, stable IDs + pagination/sorting behavior, and user-safe handling of stale estimates + API failures.
- This is intended to drive E2E automation (Playwright/Cypress) but can be used for manual verification.

Scope
- Suggestions view (list/table + details drawer)
- Batching + caching suggestions only (no quantization UI)
- Empty + error states
- Telemetry-driven staleness messaging
- UI event emission for funnel (impression/expand/dismiss/apply-click)

Out of scope (for this doc)
- Deep validation of estimator math (covered by unit/integration + Applied ML validation plan)
- Billing reconciliation
- Visual/a11y audit (see DES-669)

Test environment assumptions
- Run against staging with seeded orgs/projects representing each state (see “Test data” section).
- Feature flag: optimize_suggestions_beta (org-scoped)
- RBAC permission: optimize:suggestions:read (project scope unless otherwise specified)
- API base: /optimize/suggestions (server-side pagination)
- UI route: Console → Optimize → Suggestions (exact nav label may vary)

Test data / seed accounts (staging)
(Names are placeholders; update if seed org IDs change.)
- ORG_A “qa-suggestions-enabled”: Flag ON, telemetry present, suggestions present (>= 60 suggestions) across >= 3 routes and 2 models. Includes a mix of risk levels.
- ORG_B “qa-flag-off”: Flag OFF.
- ORG_C “qa-no-telemetry”: Flag ON, but insufficient telemetry (no aggregates, or below minimum window).
- ORG_D “qa-telemetry-lag”: Flag ON, telemetry exists but compute job lagging → suggestions stale.
- ORG_E “qa-rbac-denied”: Flag ON, user lacks optimize:suggestions:read.
- ORG_F “qa-api-error”: Flag ON; API returns controlled errors (401/403/429/500) via test proxy or header-based fault injection.

Global checks (run for every test where applicable)
- Page loads without console errors (JS) and without unhandled promise rejections.
- No cross-tenant leakage: suggestions list must only show data for selected org/project.
- Stable row identity: expanding a row and navigating pages should not mismatch details (stable suggestion_id).
- “Estimated savings” language: no “guarantee” phrasing.
- Risk label is clearly positioned as performance/reliability risk, not security.
- “Last computed / stale as of” visible when provided.


SECTION 1 — Feature flag + navigation

E2E-001: Flag OFF → Suggestions entry point hidden or blocked
Preconditions
- User has optimize:suggestions:read
- ORG_B flag OFF
Steps
1) Sign in as user with access to ORG_B
2) Navigate to Optimize section in Console
Expected
- Suggestions nav item is not shown OR is shown but entering displays gated state (copy should indicate beta access required)
- No API call to /optimize/suggestions should be made if UI hides entry point (preferred)
Notes
- Confirm expected behavior with latest implementation (some builds show a “Request access” page).

E2E-002: Flag ON → Suggestions entry point visible
Preconditions
- ORG_A flag ON
Steps
1) Sign in to ORG_A
2) Open Optimize → Suggestions
Expected
- Suggestions page renders list/table (if suggestions exist)
- API call made with correct org/project context


SECTION 2 — RBAC / permissions

E2E-010: RBAC denied (no permission) → access blocked
Preconditions
- ORG_E flag ON
- User lacks optimize:suggestions:read for selected project
Steps
1) Sign in as denied user
2) Directly navigate to Suggestions URL (deep link)
Expected
- UI shows “You don’t have access” (403) state with a CTA or guidance (e.g., “Contact your admin”)
- No suggestion rows rendered
- Ensure error state does not reveal route/model names (avoid sensitive info)
Telemetry expectations
- Page_view may fire, but no suggestion_impression events should fire

E2E-011: RBAC allowed at org but not project → behavior matches spec
Preconditions
- Multi-project org setup
- User has permission in Project 1, not in Project 2
Steps
1) Load Suggestions in Project 1
2) Switch project selector to Project 2
Expected
- Project 2 shows access denied state
- Switching back restores list

E2E-012: RBAC change while session active
Preconditions
- Start with allowed user; permission revoked mid-session
Steps
1) Load Suggestions list
2) Revoke permission (admin action) and refresh page
Expected
- Refresh results in access denied
- No stale cached list should remain visible after refresh


SECTION 3 — No telemetry / insufficient data

E2E-020: “Insufficient telemetry” empty state
Preconditions
- ORG_C flag ON
- No eligible telemetry window (below minimum request volume / missing metrics)
Steps
1) Navigate to Suggestions
Expected
- Empty state indicates insufficient telemetry and what to do next
- Should include links/CTAs to setup telemetry requirements (if present in product)
- No broken charts; no empty table headers with 0 rows unless that’s the defined pattern
Copy checks
- Must explain what data is needed in plain terms (traffic volume, cache metrics, etc.)

E2E-021: Partial telemetry (some routes eligible, others not)
Preconditions
- ORG_A has some routes with eligible data and some without
Steps
1) Load list
2) Apply filter to a route known to have no eligible data
Expected
- Filtered empty state is contextual (“No suggestions match current filters” vs “Insufficient telemetry”) per spec
- Clear “Reset filters” action

E2E-022: Telemetry arrives later → empty → list without full reload (if supported)
Preconditions
- ORG_C transitions to eligible state (simulate by backfill)
Steps
1) Load empty state
2) Trigger data readiness (or switch to another project and back)
Expected
- Next fetch shows populated list
- If UI has “Refresh” control, it works


SECTION 4 — List/table rendering + sorting

E2E-030: Default sort is deterministic and matches spec
Preconditions
- ORG_A populated (>= 20 suggestions)
Steps
1) Load Suggestions list
2) Note default sort key + direction
Expected
- Rows are sorted consistently (e.g., by estimated $/day savings desc, then stable tie-breaker)
- Pagination cursor/offset corresponds to sort order

E2E-031: Sort by savings ($/day)
Steps
1) Click Savings column header to sort desc
2) Click again to sort asc
Expected
- API called with sort parameter
- UI updates with correct direction indicator
- Switching pages retains sort

E2E-032: Sort by latency impact (p95 delta)
Expected
- Correct handling of negative vs positive deltas (e.g., -12ms is “improvement”)
- Empty/unknown latency impact values sort to bottom (confirm desired behavior)

E2E-033: Sort by risk level
Expected
- Risk ordering matches defined hierarchy (Low < Medium < High) and not alphabetical
- Tooltip copy is accessible

E2E-034: Sort by confidence (if column exists)
Expected
- Confidence ordering correct
- If confidence suppressed for some suggestions, sorting behavior is consistent


SECTION 5 — Filters + search (if implemented)

E2E-040: Filter by route
Steps
1) Apply route filter chip/dropdown
2) Confirm rows all match route
3) Remove filter
Expected
- API called with filter params
- Clear filter affordance visible

E2E-041: Filter by model
Expected
- Correct mapping of model display name vs internal ID

E2E-042: Combine filters + sort + pagination
Steps
1) Apply route filter + model filter
2) Sort by savings
3) Navigate to page 2
Expected
- Query params persist and page 2 reflects filtered/sorted dataset
- No duplication or missing rows between pages

E2E-043: “No results match filters” state
Expected
- Shows “No suggestions match your filters” (not “insufficient telemetry”)
- CTA: Reset filters


SECTION 6 — Pagination + stable IDs

E2E-050: Next/Previous page works
Preconditions
- ORG_A has >= 60 suggestions
Steps
1) Load page 1
2) Go to page 2
3) Return to page 1
Expected
- Correct number of rows per page (per UI)
- No row duplication across pages
- Page navigation doesn’t reset filters/sort

E2E-051: Stable IDs used as React keys / row identity
Steps
1) Expand a row on page 1 (open details drawer)
2) Navigate to page 2 and back to page 1
Expected
- Drawer closes appropriately OR reopens the same suggestion consistently (depending on spec)
- No “details mismatch” (drawer should never show data from a different suggestion)

E2E-052: Dataset changes between pagination calls
Preconditions
- Suggestions recompute job updates dataset while user paginates
Steps
1) Load page 1
2) Trigger recompute (or switch to ORG with frequent updates)
3) Navigate to page 2
Expected
- Pagination remains consistent (cursor-based preferred)
- If backend returns “invalid cursor”, UI handles gracefully (toast + reload list)

E2E-053: Deep link with suggestion_id (if supported)
Steps
1) Copy link to suggestion details (if UI provides)
2) Open in fresh session
Expected
- Loads list and opens correct details drawer for the suggestion_id
- If suggestion not found, show not found state without breaking list


SECTION 7 — Details drawer / explanation rendering

E2E-060: Open details drawer
Steps
1) Click a suggestion row
Expected
- Drawer opens with: title, route, model, savings estimate, latency impact, risk label, explanation, assumptions, “how to enable” steps, and last computed timestamp
- Drawer content scrolls independently (if long)

E2E-061: Drawer shows “why we recommend this” and guardrails
Expected
- Explanation references telemetry inputs at a high level (e.g., “high concurrency”, “low cache hit rate”) without exposing raw sensitive request content
- Guardrails are visible when risk is Medium/High (e.g., suggested rollout pattern, monitor p95)

E2E-062: Links to config pages work
Steps
1) Click “Apply” / “View config” / “Go to caching settings” link
Expected
- Navigates to correct route/model config page
- Returns back to Suggestions keeps state (filters/sort) if designed

E2E-063: Risk tooltip and copy
Expected
- Tooltip copy matches latest risk definitions (performance/reliability)
- No mention of security/privacy risk
- Tooltips are keyboard accessible


SECTION 8 — Stale estimates / compute lag

E2E-070: Stale suggestions banner or label shown
Preconditions
- ORG_D suggestions have stale_as_of older than threshold
Steps
1) Load list
Expected
- UI indicates staleness (banner on page and/or label per row)
- Copy: “Estimates may be out of date” + last computed time

E2E-071: Stale suggestions still usable but with caution
Expected
- Details drawer shows staleness clearly
- “Apply” CTA (if present) is not disabled unless spec says so
- Risk copy does not change due to staleness; staleness is separate dimension

E2E-072: Fresh recompute clears staleness
Steps
1) Load stale state
2) Trigger recompute
3) Refresh
Expected
- Staleness label removed; last computed updated


SECTION 9 — API error states / resilience

E2E-080: 500 from suggestions API
Preconditions
- ORG_F or fault injection enabled
Steps
1) Load Suggestions
Expected
- Shows “Something went wrong” error state with Retry
- Retry triggers re-fetch
- No infinite loading spinner

E2E-081: Timeout / network error
Steps
1) Block network / simulate timeout
Expected
- Error state with Retry
- If partial UI renders, avoid showing stale cached data without labeling it

E2E-082: 429 rate limited
Expected
- Friendly message: “Too many requests” + retry after
- Backoff behavior if implemented (no rapid re-tries)

E2E-083: 401 unauthorized (session expired)
Steps
1) Expire auth token
2) Load Suggestions
Expected
- Redirect to login OR show re-auth prompt
- No data shown

E2E-084: 403 (RBAC) returned from API while UI thinks allowed
Preconditions
- Permission revoked between initial authz check and API call
Expected
- UI converts to access denied state (not generic error)

E2E-085: Malformed payload / missing fields
Preconditions
- Inject response missing optional fields (confidence, latency delta)
Expected
- UI degrades gracefully: shows “—” or “Not enough data”
- No crash


SECTION 10 — Telemetry events (funnel instrumentation)

E2E-090: Impression event fires once per page view
Steps
1) Load list
2) Confirm event(s) emitted
Expected
- suggestion_list_impression event emitted once per view (not once per row)
- Includes org_id, project_id, filters, sort, page_size, page_number/cursor, and feature_flag state (as allowed)
- Does NOT include prompt or raw request content

E2E-091: Expand event
Steps
1) Open details drawer for a suggestion
Expected
- suggestion_expand event includes suggestion_id, suggestion_type (batching|caching), route_id, model_id, risk_level

E2E-092: Dismiss event
Steps
1) Dismiss a suggestion (if UI supports)
Expected
- suggestion_dismiss event emitted with reason (if collected)
- UI updates row state accordingly

E2E-093: Apply-click event
Steps
1) Click “Apply” / “Go to settings”
Expected
- suggestion_apply_click emitted
- If routed to config page, capture destination


SECTION 11 — Edge cases / regressions

E2E-100: Very long route names / model names
Expected
- Table truncation + tooltip, no overflow

E2E-101: Mixed units formatting
Expected
- Currency formatting correct ($/day), percentages with sensible rounding, latency deltas in ms
- Negative values display with sign and are understandable

E2E-102: Zero savings suggestions (should not appear)
Expected
- Suggestions with negligible savings are filtered out per backend rules OR clearly labeled (confirm desired)

E2E-103: Cross-region org
Expected
- If region filter exists: correct behavior
- If region shown in details: accurate

E2E-104: Multi-tab behavior
Steps
1) Open Suggestions in two tabs
2) Change filters in tab A
Expected
- Tab B unaffected; no shared state bugs


Known open questions (track + resolve)
- What is the canonical empty state precedence when both “no suggestions” and “insufficient telemetry” are plausible? (Confirm rules.)
- Should the UI make an API call when feature flag is OFF but user deep-links directly? (If yes, what state do we show?)
- Stable ID semantics: is suggestion_id stable across recomputes when only estimates change, or can it rotate? (Impacts deep links and E2E assertions.)
- Expected behavior when pagination cursor invalidates due to recompute: toast + reload vs silent reload.

Notes for automation implementation
- Prefer data-testid selectors for: table rows, sort headers, filter controls, drawer open/close, empty/error states, banner labels.
- Avoid asserting exact savings numbers (they’re estimates and may change). Assert presence + formatting + monotonic ordering for sorting.
- For staleness: assert relative age threshold and presence of timestamps, not exact date.
- For RBAC: create dedicated test users in staging with explicit role bindings.

Change log
- 2026-02-07 (Leila): initial checklist drafted from PRD + design spec.
- 2026-02-18 (Nora/Felix): added pagination + stable ID regression cases after API perf work.
- 2026-02-27 (Leila): expanded API error state coverage and clarified telemetry event expectations.
